verdict_text:
YES

The keep-index construction reproduces the required column/row ranges exactly: for `c_attn.weight`/`c_attn.bias` it walks the three 768-wide q/k/v segments and drops only head 5's 64-wide block in each, yielding `0..319, 384..767, 768..1087, 1152..1535, 1536..1855, 1920..2303` in order (clauses 1–2); for `c_proj.weight` it drops rows `320..383` on axis 0, giving `[704, 768]` (clause 3). All other tensors and all names are untouched (clause 4), and the four required checks run before `save_file`, which writes a single `out/T2/model.safetensors` (clauses 5 and "Required checks").
